language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, my name is Hanale! Meet my friend, Tim! Today, we're at a beach on Hawaii to spend a day out in the sun.
Look how beautiful the beach looks – the tempting smell of food that is cooked around makes me feel hungry.
Let's play a game! I will present different items in front of you. You have to guess the name of each item using your senses. If you guessed it right, I will buy an ice cream for you as a reward.
That will be great Tim, but I know little about senses. Can you help me understand the use of senses while playing?
Of course, let's get started!

We use our nose to smell. Being able to smell things, helps us decide if food is still fresh, if something is burning or if your body is healthy and clean.
It's very important to keep our nose in good health so we are able to smell. Let's take a look at these items. Can you drag them to the correct basket?

Look at the beautiful rainbow! We use our eyes to see things around us. This sense of sight helps us to move around, to locate things, to read and write, and to do all the daily chores. Can you help me answer these questions about sight?
